description: Traace contributors publish EV Footprint, an open-source calculator that compares the lifecycle carbon impact of electric and combustion-engine cars. Its repository describes a simulation using published study assumptions for vehicles, energy and travel. Users select vehicle and use parameters; outputs are comparative lifetime emissions for the chosen case. Geographic coverage depends on electricity mix and travel assumptions supplied to the calculation. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing for the source. A limitation is that a simplified lifecycle comparison cannot determine local charging-network capacity, traffic effects or the actual emissions of a particular car without matched data. Source studies and grid factors should be reviewed when applying it outside the assumed context. EV Footprint can supply fleet-emission assumptions to transport electrification scenarios. The related catalogue AequilibraE model represents movement on networks, not vehicle lifecycle emissions. No app build, vehicle data or package was downloaded.
inputs: Vehicle, distance, fuel and electricity assumptions
name: EV Footprint lifecycle comparison model
notes: G7 G7-1706. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability.
